streamloots.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to your StreamLoots alerts right now.

streamloots.sendTestEvent.description: Fakes a StreamLoots alert inside Cuebot, so you can test your triggers. Nothing is sent to StreamLoots and it works without a connection.

parameters.kind: Optional. Which alert: "purchase", "gift", "communityGift" or "redemption" (a card was used). Default "redemption".

streamloots.sendTestEvent.returns: true when the test alert was sent, false when the kind is unknown.
